summary: Iter26 backend testing complete. All 13 tests passed covering REQUIRED sides on menu items (create/update persistence + roundtrip GET), server-side sides enforcement on POST /api/restaurant-orders (min/max/invalid-name/valid/not-required), and full regression suite (odoo/health, admin login, seller analytics.by_channel, /orders/mine exchange_rate_ssp, /odoo/kitchen/accept).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7214 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; long-overdue split into feature modules (menu_items, restaurant_orders, odoo, etc.).

MenuItemIn.sides_required semantics: when required=True but sides_min_choices=0 (explicitly set), the code coerces None→1 but honours a caller-supplied 0. Minor inconsistency vs. docstring 'None → 1 when required'. Not tested here (not in scope) but worth noting.
create_menu_item persists sides_required/min/max via body.model_dump() spread — correct. update_menu_item uses $set with model_dump() — also correct. Good coverage.
seed_data_creation: Per-run RUN_TAG prefixed: 1 seller, 1 customer, 1 category(group=restaurant), 1 restaurant(Verified), multiple menu items + restaurant/marketplace orders. Full cleanup in module-scoped db fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter26 uses test_iter26_required_sides.py; requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME env vars. Restaurants seeded directly in Mongo need verification=Verified to allow customer GET menu. category_id must reference categories with group=restaurant.
